events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I don't know which underlying model runs me.

I can reset your password and look up support tickets. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is on extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To continue with the reset, I'll need your employee ID. The reset link goes to the phone registered on your account.
